connector.name: TriliumNext (trilium-mcp)
connector.registryDescription: Read and write a self-hosted TriliumNext knowledge base over its ETAPI.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image trilium-mcp:0.1.5. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the ovden13 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: TRILIUM_URL
env.description: Base URL of the Trilium ETAPI. Comma-separated for failover: fast LAN first, public fallback (e.g. http://192.168.0.10:8092,https://memo.example.com).

env.name: TRILIUM_TOKEN
env.description: ETAPI token created in Trilium under Options -> ETAPI

env.name: TRILIUM_MCP_LOG
env.description: Tool-call log level on stderr: off / info (default) / debug
